budget_items.topic: Property condition assessment remediation and demolition costs
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Vertex property condition assessment was reported to require about $3.4 million in remediation for six buildings plus $400K to demolish the Old Primary School.
budget_items.quote: about 3.4 million dollars' worth of our remediation to six of the buildings and $400k to demolish the old primary school

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Capital outlays for the six remaining buildings over the next several years were reported at 8.6 million dollars.
budget_items.quote: beyond that capital out lays through the next several years of 8.6 million dollars for the six remaining buildings.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The capital improvement request for 2020 to 2023 was 5.3 million dollars, about 1.3 million dollars per year.
budget_items.quote: the capital improvement request for the next four years, 2020 - 2023 which is 5.3 million dollars or about average of 1.3 million dollars per year.

budget_items.topic: Average capital expenditures FY16 and FY17
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Average capital expenditures for FY16 and FY17 were about $600K.
budget_items.quote: the average capital expenditures were about $600k.

budget_items.topic: Free cash certification and Turkey Hill asbestos remediation
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Free cash rose after FY17 close to FY18 close; $130k is available for Turkey Hill Elementary asbestos remediation, now state-funded.
budget_items.quote: we now have $130k for the asbestos remediation at the turkey hill elementary school

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A $480k borrowing authorization for part of the ladder truck was discussed, with a proposal to pay for it with free cash instead to avoid interest.
budget_items.quote: the barrowing authorization of $480k for a portion of the ladder truck

budget_items.topic: Free cash available end of FY18 and FY19
budget_items.what_was_recorded: If the ladder truck borrowing were eliminated, close to a million dollars would be available at the end of this fiscal year and FY20.
budget_items.quote: there would be close to a million dollars available for the end of this fiscal year and fiscal year 20.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Excise revenue has grown; the town has been raising estimates by $50K plus to fund pavement management in General Highway Maintenance.
budget_items.quote: terri asked if it was coming in at basically $50k a year or significantly more?

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Local receipt estimate was $2,940,817.00 against actual collections of $3,468,170.00, an increase of $527K.
budget_items.quote: the local receipt estimate was $2,940,817.00. the actual collection was $3,468,170.00 so there was an increase

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Motor vehicle excise came in $207,000.00 above the estimated amount.
budget_items.quote: there was an increase in motor vehicle excise from the estimated amount of $207,000.00

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Penalties and interest on taxes came in $135,000.00 above estimate, mostly from the collector's pursuit of real estate taxes.
budget_items.quote: there was an increase in penalties and interest on taxes which was increased $135,000.00

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Departmental revenue from schools (state money for Medicaid-eligible students) was $103,000.00 more than estimated.
budget_items.quote: there was also $103,000.00 more in departmental revenue schools

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town received $511,000.00 in tax lien revenue in 2018, about $400,000.00 better than the prior year.
budget_items.quote: received $511,000.00 in tax lien revenue in 2018 which was about $400,000.00 better than the previous year

budget_items.what_was_recorded: $119K was budgeted for the 40S reimbursement, but the state indicated the town will receive around $20k after proration.
budget_items.quote: on the cherry sheet there was $119k that was budgeted for the 40s reimbursement

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town had $399K in appropriation closeouts.
budget_items.quote: the town does have $399k in appropriation closeouts

budget_items.topic: Choice and charter tuition state assessments
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Choice and charter tuition assessments for out-of-district students came in $290K below the amount assessed on the cherry sheet; this is not guaranteed year to year.
budget_items.quote: was $290k less than the amount that was received as an assessment on the cherry sheet

budget_items.topic: Health, liability and workers comp insurance lines
budget_items.what_was_recorded: About $130K surplus in insurance lines from better rates and retirees not replaced.
budget_items.quote: there was about $130k in our health, liability, and workers comp insurance lines

budget_items.topic: Debt service share of town budget
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Debt service was described as 13% of the town budget, which the chair tracks over time.
budget_items.quote: terri went on to say debt services is 13% of our towns budget

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The fire chief said the purchase would not exceed the town's approved budget and would use the state bidding process.
budget_items.quote: chief is finalizing his new specs for the towns new fire truck and the purchase will not exceed the towns approved budget.
